additionalDescription: Building a database from scratch taught me more about computer science fundamentals than any course ever could. From implementing B-trees to designing a query optimizer, every component required deep understanding of data structures and algorithms. The result is a database that is both powerful and approachable.
highlights: Designed a hybrid storage engine supporting both document and relational models
Implemented ACID transactions with optimistic concurrency control
Built a query language that combines SQL familiarity with JSON flexibility
Created automatic indexing based on query pattern analysis
